title: mail-arrives-and-what-cannot-marks-itself
intention: Every envelope the bus carries reaches a device that can consume it — and every place that cannot yet is DERIVED by measurement and marks itself as work, so the catchup to-do list maintains itself instead of being kept by hand.
why: Measured 2026-08-11, and it is the second half of the same silence the postman closed. The bus posted durable envelopes; nothing drained an inbox; BaseShim.deliver stood with zero callers since the day it was written. With the postman built and live-fired, the mail now moves — and the first drain reported that NOTHING ON THE ROSTER CAN TAKE IT: the librarian (the one device with a real receive) refuses every channel that can exist, harbor_master has five envelopes waiting and no device behind its shim, and two envelopes are addressed to a name nothing has ever answered to. Akien, on being shown this: 'we need to make sure all the devices can consume all their messages and that they're not pointed in the wrong place and so on.' THE TRACKING IS HALF THE INTENTION, not a process note: a hand-kept list of broken devices is the stale-list failure he ruled against for the ground loop, and hand-placing a marker at each broken site is that same maintained list in distributed form — a site nobody thought of stays silent forever. So the census DERIVES the list from measurement at one address, and a device added tomorrow gets its red row for free.
traces_to: Law 7 — 'Errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces and permanent in records of truth.' A message that cannot be delivered, failing silently, IS the violation, and it is the trouble lane's founding example in Akien's own words (2026-07-25, carried verbatim in cairn/devices/trouble's charter: 'a poke into nothing, a message that can't be delivered, these are bugs. nothing should fail silently. everything that can't escalate somewhere...'). Also Law 3 (the census is the measurement that turns 'which devices are broken' from a hypothesis into a reading) and Law 9 (the census is precisely the 'site plan showing which lots are still unexcavated' that CLAUDE.md's own Law-9 IOU names as missing).

proves_green.prove_gate: the tester runs this node's proofs and emits a VALIDATION — verdict and seal from the same hand (TesterDevice().run_proof(..., isolation='netns')). Teeth a hollow build could not pass: the census reds a genuinely unreachable ADDRESSED device; the census stays GREEN on a device nobody mails (the false-red case gets its own tooth, because that is the failure that turns the lane into wallpaper); a raised trouble clears on a measured green; a recurrence writes a FRESH ticket rather than bumping a count.
proves_green.feeds_back_on_failure: a red criterion at the verdict is a kick-back to the chart chain, not an argument with the gate (Laws 3 + 8)
proves_green.extra_gates: durability — committed and pushed, verified with git plumbing rather than narration
proves_green.entry_exit_physics: BUILDME refuses without a berthed chart chain claiming this ticket plus sorted_berth and intent_berth; PROVED refuses without a complete passing verdict artifact; and because the string carries WATCHME, the emission gate refuses the crossing unless the probe is ARMED at the berth named in watchme.probe.

falsifier.proves_red: AMENDED 2026-08-11 by Akien's ruling (see `amendments`) — the census this falsifier was written against is dead. DONE when every device on the roster answers a health query, and no envelope sits in transit undelivered for want of a receiver across more than a few beats. Read from the instrument (the answers themselves and the trouble store), never from narration. WRONG INTENT if a device that cannot answer turns out to be a legitimate resting state rather than a bug or an unbuilt thing — which Akien's ruling says it never is, so this is now a falsifier aimed at HIS spec rather than at the measure.
falsifier.horizon: The repairs are small and known-shaped: days, not weeks. The WATCHME's horizon is deliberately longer and runs past this node's close — it cannot begin counting until the PROVED crossing sets its era floor.

how: Ensure every bus envelope reaches a device that can consume it. Derive by measurement which devices cannot yet receive, and mark those as work-in-progress. Children decompose: trouble banner, librarian personal acceptance, harbor-master shim, dave envelopes, remaining health-sweep-derived children.

decisions.text: BusShim.__init__(self, bus, heartbeat=None, limit=DRAIN_LIMIT) in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/shim.py: the heartbeat becomes optional, because the roster constructs every concrete shim as cls(bus=bus) (bus_client._load_device_shim) and today 'bus' alone raises TypeError there (measured 2026-10-03). _deliver_one with no heartbeat answers outcome 'no_shim' with the lack 'no heartbeat roster held' instead of raising. Nothing else in the bus shim changes; the server's verbs op then answers get status for 'bus' exactly as for every other roster name.
decisions.step: unlisted: the bus answers its health query

decisions.text: BusDevice (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py) gains set_no_receiver(callback) and post() calls it for a PERSONAL envelope that has no delivery hook and no folder delivery AND carries no reply_to (a reply is correlated mail: request() reads it by reply_to and receipts it in the asker's hand, ticket 6b1e13704e17; measured 2026-10-03, every addressee without a shim in 30 days of traffic — proof, constrain, tester-proof-*, test_the_wiring_needs_no_loop — was a requester receiving replies). An is_bounce envelope is the one reply_to exception: it takes the path, so the sender is woken to read its returned letter. The bus server (server.py BusProcess) installs the callback at construction: hold_name(addressee, wire=True), whose _wire runs the shim's _wire_delivery, which drains the addressee's mail at once through _check_mail — the wake, in the same post call, no flush and no pulse. A device nobody mails is never held by this path.
decisions.step: unlisted: a post with no receiver wakes the addressee

decisions.text: Still in server.py's callback: when hold_name raises LookupError (no shim answers) or the envelope is still in bus.undelivered(to=addressee) after the wake (a DiscoveredShim's _check_mail returns outcome no_receiver because it cannot wake a device), the bus bounces once: post(sender='bus', to=<original sender>, channel='personal', why='bounced: <reason>', body={is_bounce: True, reason, original_verb, original_addressee, original_sender, trouble: 'mail-<addressee>-has-no-receiver'}, reply_to=<original id>) and receipts the original with record_delivery(id, to=addressee, by='bus-bounced-no-receiver') so it leaves transit. A bounce that itself cannot land (no sender, or the sender is still not taking it after its own wake) is NEVER bounced again: the bus raises its trouble with BusDevice.raise_trouble(<body.trouble>, why='bounced: <reason> — and the sender <s> could not take the returned letter', detail={sender, receiver, bounce: True, envelope}) and receipts the bounce with by='bus-bounce-undeliverable'. At start, serve() runs ONE pass over bus.undelivered() (to=None) through the same callback for every envelope without reply_to, in a thread started after the socket is bound so a client is never kept waiting by a slow wake — an event (the bus starting), never a beat.
decisions.step: unlisted: mail no shim can take returns to its sender

decisions.text: BaseShim.handle_bounce (cairn/tools/base/shim.py) keeps its bounced_mail emit and adds raise_trouble(identity, why=bounce_envelope's why (it begins 'bounced: ', so the parent's does-the-bounce-blame-the-right-party probe counts it), detail={sender: self.device_id, receiver: body.original_addressee, bounce: True, original_verb, envelope: bounce reply_to}). identity is body['trouble'] when the bouncer named one, else 'mail-<original_addressee>-bounced' (old letters). _bounce_to_sender gains the defect: body['trouble'] = 'mail-<addressee>-has-no-verb-<verb>' for an undeclared or uncallable verb, 'mail-<addressee>-has-no-receive' for a verbless envelope to a device with no receive(). The identity names the ADDRESSEE's defect, so many senders fold into one trouble; the trouble store slugs it (identity_of), so no sanitizing here. A subclass that overrides handle_bounce owns its own (Law 6); none does today (grep 2026-10-03).
decisions.step: unlisted: the sender raises the mail trouble

decisions.text: BaseShim._check_mail, after deliver() returns for an envelope that is not is_bounce and whose result is not a bounce ({'bounced': True}), emits clear_trouble('mail-<own device_id>-has-no-receiver', by='cc', what_changed='<device_id> took envelope <id> from <sender>') once per process (a flag on the shim), and when the envelope carried a verb, clear_trouble('mail-<own id>-has-no-verb-<verb>', ...) once per verb per process. by='cc' is the machine-measured-clear precedent (build inspector, data_recorder). The trouble shim's fold declines a clear on a non-live identity, so the clear is cheap; a recurrence after the clear is a raise on a CLEARED identity, which the store already writes as a fresh trouble with prior_attempts+1 — the proof drives that through the trouble shim's _fold on a scratch store rather than changing the fold.
decisions.step: unlisted: a shim that takes mail clears its trouble

decisions.text: cairn/tools/base/probes/does_the_mail_lane_get_worked.py, modeled on does_the_bounce_blame_the_right_party.py beside it: reads CairnCommons/troubles/*.json for ids starting 'mail-' with first_seen after the era floor (this ticket's PROVED crossing, written as a literal at the crossing), counts raised, cleared (standing CLEARED), live with age, and prior_attempts>0 recurrences; trigger fires when a live one is older than 14 days, or more than 20 are live with a median age above the median at the last survey; enough is >=8 raised AND >=6 cleared AND none live past 14 days; carry names the four counts, the live ages and any recurred ids, ticket via owning_ticket, against_falsifier. Declares a module-level PROBE with carry and enough so watchme_spec.armed_error returns None. What evaluates it on the mail-* raise/clear event is 164da559823d/acb4ecd84364's, not this ticket's.

Two proofs, both run by TesterDevice().run_proof(..., isolation='netns'): cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_mail_without_a_receiver.py (a scratch BusDevice + BusProcess with throwaway shim classes held by name: get status answers for 'bus'; a sleeping addressee is woken by its mail in the same post; a device nobody mails is never held; mail to an unshimmed name and to a DiscoveredShim-like shim that cannot wake returns one bounce to the sender and leaves transit; an undeliverable bounce raises and is not re-bounced; the standing backlog takes the path at start; a reply_to envelope to a shimless requester is neither woken nor bounced) and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_bounce_raises_the_mail_trouble.py (handle_bounce emits raise_trouble with the addressee's identity and sender/receiver detail, captured with set_diagnostic_receiver; a genuine take emits the clear once; a bounce is not a take; a raise after a clear folds to a fresh trouble with prior_attempts 1 through the trouble shim's fold on a scratch store). Each carries PROVES naming 7cb1989e7825 with one tooth per falsifier clause.

record_delivery is BusDevice.record_delivery(envelope_id, *, to, by) at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py:560 — it exists, it appends the receipt to the in-memory ring and pops the envelope from _pending, and flush() writes it through db_domain's store with the rest of the ring. The server's callback calls it on its own bus object (same component); no new method, no new import.

No new detection: BaseShim.deliver (cairn/tools/base/shim.py) already decides it at its three _bounce_to_sender call sites — (1) the envelope's verb, after canon(), is not in the device's declared_verbs() → 'mail-<addressee>-has-no-verb-<verb>'; (2) the verb is declared but its handler is not callable → the same identity; (3) no verb on the envelope and the device has no callable receive() → 'mail-<addressee>-has-no-receive'. _bounce_to_sender gains a keyword trouble=<identity> and each site passes its own; it puts it in the body. <addressee> is self.device_id at those sites; <verb> is the envelope's verb as sent.

The era floor is read at runtime, not hand-written: the probe reads cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/history.json (the component the crossing is recorded at) and takes the 'at' of the last entry with ticket == '7cb1989e7825' and to == 'PROVED'. Until that entry exists the survey reports era 'not begun' and both trigger and enough are False (nothing to count yet — the WATCHME crossing precedes PROVED). If the history no longer holds the entry (Law 5 moved it to the commons) the survey is hollow and the trigger fires, loud, so the probe is repaired rather than silently counting from nothing.

The falsifier's teeth, as amended 2026-08-11, and the tooth that carries each (PROVES keys are these clause names): 'a genuinely unreachable ADDRESSED device reds' → bus proof teeth 'unreachable addressed mail returns to its sender' and base proof tooth 'a returned letter raises the addressee's mail trouble'; 'a device nobody mails stays GREEN' → bus tooth 'a device nobody mails is never held' plus 'a reply to a shimless requester is neither woken nor bounced'; 'a raised trouble clears on a measured green' → base tooth 'taking mail clears the trouble; a bounce is not a take'; 'a recurrence writes a FRESH ticket' → base tooth 'a recurrence after the clear is a fresh trouble'; proves_red's 'every device answers a health query' → bus tooth 'the bus answers get status'; proves_red's 'no envelope sits for want of a receiver' → bus teeth 'a sleeping addressee is woken by its mail', 'an undeliverable bounce is raised, not re-bounced' and 'the standing backlog takes the path at start'. The census clauses are dead (amendments[0]) and get no tooth.

A bounce answering a request still awaited inside Bus.request is the asker's to take by correlation (6b1e13704e17), so post() does not hand it to the no-receiver callback: request() posts with _asked=True, the bus keeps that id in _asked until request() returns. Measured 2026-10-03 at the build: without it a shimless asker's request to an undeclared verb (the live 60cc220da787 proof) made the bus raise mail-<target>-has-no-verb-<verb> on every run, a trouble no take ever clears. Held by the bus proof's tooth a_bounce_answering_a_waiting_request_is_the_askers_to_take, red with the guard defeated.

RULE 1 correction to the base proof: the recurrence tooth asserts only that a raise after a clear carries the IDENTICAL identity and is not suppressed by the clear-once flag; the trouble device's proven fold (a raise on a CLEARED identity becomes a fresh ticket, prior_attempts+1) is trusted, never driven from cairn/tools/base. The bus proof gains an eighth tooth (the asker's bounce, see D2).

The probe holds no state between firings, so 'a rising median age' is read off the store: the median age of live mail-* troubles stands above the median time the cleared ones took to clear (cleared_by[-1].at minus first_seen) — the lane fills faster than it drains. With no clears yet the clear median is 0, so more than 20 live counts as crowding.

test_one_bus_process's flush tooth posted an uncorrelated throwaway to bus_proof_nobody; under D3 the scratch bus process now returns it and raises mail-bus_proof_nobody-has-no-receiver into the LIVE logs tree (measured 2026-10-03, one emission, trashed before the drain). The throwaway becomes a reply (reply_to='bus-proof-throwaway'), which the bus leaves for its asker: the tooth still has ring content to flush and raises nothing.
decisions.step: unlisted: a live-fire proof posts throwaway mail

decisions.text: Measured 2026-10-03 at cairn/tools/base/probe.py: Probe is a dataclass constructed by keyword — Probe(why: str, trigger: (now, context) -> bool, to: str, verb='', channel='personal', body={}, carry: (context) -> dict | None, while_true=False, enough: (context) -> bool | None, horizon: int | None). The mail-lane probe passes why, trigger, to='harbor_master', body={'nexus':'hypothesize','kind':'efficacy'}, carry, enough, horizon=1000 — the same keywords as its parent does_the_bounce_blame_the_right_party.py — and watchme_spec.armed_error returns None over the ticket's watchme.
